verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Disputes API with a 'Process Disputes' guide and sandbox testing for disputes. Its official MCP server lists 'disputes' in its service catalog and offers a generic make_api_request tool, so an agent can reach dispute endpoints directly. The evidence pack is mostly link titles, though, so the specific steps of retrieving disputes, uploading evidence and submitting the response are not shown in any detail. missing for 10: documented evidence-upload and submit-evidence endpoints, explicit dispute retrieval/listing details, an agent-driven end-to-end dispute workflow example, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API

citations.quote: customers, orders, invoices, disputes, bookings, giftcards
